answer_1.quote: We redefine the Chinese Spelling Correction (CSC) task to require the model to output the positions of incorrect characters along with their corrections.
answer_1.outputs: Corrected sentences with position annotations (position, incorrect character, correction) and/or corrected text.

answer_2.quote: We introduced several metrics. Position Prediction Accuracy (PPA) is defined as... Precision (CP) is the proportion of incorrect characters identified by the model that is actually incorrect. Recall (CR) is the proportion of actual incorrect characters that are correctly identified.
